sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Lightning Release, Earth Release

system.description:
You slam your fists into each other as you focus the explosive energy into a single point before releasing it like a focused beam of destruction. All creatures in a 5-foot wide, 60-foot-long line must make a Dexterity saving throw taking 3d12 force damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.

Barriers treat damage from this jutsu as if they are vulnerable to it. Creatures with Temporary hit points that fail their saving throw reduce their temporary hit points to 0 before performing damage calculations.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d12. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher you can change the range of this jutsu to instead a 30-foot cone and all creatures benefiting from a Barrier makes their saving throw at disadvantage.
